svg.title: Same defects, large die versus small die
svg.desc: Two identical wafers with the same defect positions. Large dies are mostly hit and fail; small dies mostly survive.
svg.text: Identical defect positions on both wafers. A die fails if even one defect lands on it. (illustrative, D0 = 0.15 per cm², 300 mm wafer)
Y = e−A·D0 (A = die area, D0 = defect density)
